title: Profile card with gradient aura header and overlapping white panel

observed.layout: Rounded-square card. The top shows a soft gradient aura (blue-grey at edges, orange-pink at center) with a white inner panel overlapping it; the avatar breaks the panel's top-left edge. Content: name 'Verona Nov', two tinted tags (Writer, Golden User), a two-line grey bio, a large black pill 'Follow' with a plus icon, and two circular outline icon buttons (message, bell).
observed.hierarchy: Name, then the black Follow pill; bio and tags are secondary.
observed.typography: Geometric sans; large name, light-grey bio. Unconfirmed.
observed.materials: Blurred gradient header, white panel, soft long shadow.

interpretation.aesthetic: Soft, airy social/creator profile; the aura adds personality without photography.
implementation_notes: Aura: layered radial gradients or blurred blobs.
Avatar overlap via negative margin and a white ring.
Tags: low-saturation tinted pills with darker text.

concept_work.essence: Personality from a gradient, authority from a single black action.
what_makes_it_work: Clear information order for a profile.
One dominant action; secondary actions are visually quieter.
Tags use tint + dark text for legibility.
gaps_to_make_it_work: Message and bell buttons are unlabeled.
An auto-generated aura could clash with avatar colors.

pattern.name: Profile card with gradient aura header and overlapping panel
use_when: Cards that need personality without relying on photography
free_to_vary: aura palette (could derive from avatar or interests)
adaptation_examples: Marketplace seller card: aura from shop color, Follow becomes Visit shop.
Team directory: neutral aura, Follow becomes Message.

lessons: Let one element carry the strongest contrast; keep everything else quieter.
Tinted pills with dark text are a reliable way to add color safely.

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
palette: warm orange in the aura gradient (sampled)
blue-grey and pink blend in the aura
measured.color_roles: White card, soft gradient aura as the only color, black as the single strong action.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from the compressed image: background = dominant color in the measured box, foreground = mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels, ratio = WCAG relative-luminance contrast. Thin or anti-aliased text biases toward lower ratios; values within 0.3 of a threshold (3.0 or 4.5) are marked near_threshold and should be verified in the source file.

purpose.evidence: Information fits a creator profile and the main action is obvious.

visual.evidence: Balanced composition; the overlap and aura give depth with restraint.

discipline.evidence: Profile hierarchy (avatar, name, tags, bio, primary and secondary actions) follows conventions.

usability.evidence: Primary action is unmistakable; follow state, hover and message/notification meaning are not shown.

consistency.evidence: Shared radii, outline icon weight and pill shapes throughout.

originality.evidence: Gradient-header profile cards are common; execution is refined rather than novel.

evidence: primary text min 20.55:1; secondary text min 4.39:1; icon min 11.77:1; non-color state cue: True.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion, screen-reader support are not assessable from a static image)

evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
